items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I was late on my job, the first time in my life I was ever late on my job with Grant Moore, watching Gene.

ctx.x: He's a bandleader, he had a great band.

George E. Lee, oh please. Now this is a thing that we don't go into because peoples don't know about George E. Lee. They don't know about Eli Rice. They don't know nothing about Grant Moore. When Eddie Tompkins, when Jabbo Smith - I said Eddie Tompkins, you know, that later went with Jimmie Lunceford - you got Jabbo Smith, Eddie Tompkins -
